```{r}
source(file.path(root, "scripts", "setup", "summary", "gmmResults.R"))
```

For the reference cells of the chapter, at the $V_{S30}=760$ m/s reference rock condition, each tectonic regime is evaluated at its own magnitude, epicentral distance, and focal depth. The mean PGA of the weighted mixture spans `r .fmt(GMMSummary$reference[, min(PGA.mean)], 3)` to `r .fmt(GMMSummary$reference[, max(PGA.mean)], 3)` g over those cells, a range that reflects both the differences between the regimes and the different cells at which each is evaluated. The corresponding p5–p95 band, bounded by the 5th and 95th percentiles of the conditional distribution of each cell, has a p95/p5 ratio of `r .fmt(GMMSummary$reference[, min(PGA.p95 / PGA.p05)], 1)` to `r .fmt(GMMSummary$reference[, max(PGA.p95 / PGA.p05)], 1)`. Between the ends of the attenuation curves, which cover epicentral distances from `r .fmti(round(GMMSummary$attenuation[, min(Repi.near)]))` to `r .fmti(round(GMMSummary$attenuation[, max(Repi.far)]))` km, the median PGA decreases by a factor of `r .fmt(GMMSummary$attenuation[, min(PGA.p50.near / PGA.p50.far)], 1)` to `r .fmt(GMMSummary$attenuation[, max(PGA.p50.near / PGA.p50.far)], 1)` depending on the regime. The median spectra reach their maximum between $T_n=`r .fmt(GMMSummary$spectrum[, min(Tn.peak)], 2)`$ and $`r .fmt(GMMSummary$spectrum[, max(Tn.peak)], 2)`$ s, with peak ordinates of `r .fmt(GMMSummary$spectrum[, min(Sa.p50.peak)], 3)` to `r .fmt(GMMSummary$spectrum[, max(Sa.p50.peak)], 3)` g; among those maxima, the widest relative band corresponds to `r GMMSummary$spectrum[which.max(Sa.band.factor), TRT]`, with a p95/p5 ratio of `r .fmt(GMMSummary$spectrum[which.max(Sa.band.factor), Sa.band.factor], 1)`. This separation combines the aleatory variability of each model with the dispersion across the branches of the mixture.
